card.name: Because after a warning not to use
card.fires_on: The reason-introducing word (because, since, because of, due to, reasons) right after a statement that something is not recommended, should be avoided or not advisable. It is mostly in drug-label warnings.

modes.label: Reason after a caution
modes.description: Because, since or due to follows a not-recommended or avoid statement and introduces the reason.

modes.description: Because follows a general statement of preference or importance, outside drug warnings.
